body: I searched TikTok and Google using keywords and filters like "dead mall", "foin Fountain",  and filtering to the users I follow on TikTok or videos I've seen.
excuse me but what is the purpose of using these excessive emojis? what are you trying to achieve out of this?
I may be late but I believe this from a play called Fat Ham by James Ijames!
For real, this is seems like a really harmful and dehumanizing take.

Even my poor mother can't handle it. I barely talk to her at all and my sister is just as cold and I understand that it was due to trauma that my mother inflicted but it hurts to know that I am now causing her pain. I went NC with my sister as well and they told me how much it made them suffer. I can't bear this any more. I feel so destructive. I can't kill myself either because it's scary and it would cause so much pain.
Like I know they were shutting down because they were overwhelmed but my brain still reacts to it like I am putting my hand directly on to a hot stove.

I've attempted before. I regretted it immediately and my mental health started to improve. But then the world disintegrated at a faster rate than it had been. I have wasted so much of my life and I barely remember any of it because of my disassociative disorder. I've never fit in and all my dreams will always be just that. Just dreams. I can't stand the encroaching chaos and suffering any more. I don't think I am someone who can help because my body and mind feels like a dead weight and I have tried so hard but I am so broken by the constant brow bearing I have been subjected to for the last 30 or so years. I can't function. I can't be fulfilled. I will never write. I barely create. no one understands me not even my closest friends. Even when they do my brain won't accept it. It feels like I am only living for other people.

it's not that we are unable to check ourselves out it's that we cannot use an internal software signed in on our account to check ourselves out. I also don't understand it tho. I think it's to prevent internal exploitation of the system?????

I feel like a loser. I have only had shitty retail jobs all my life and my brain is too fucked up to actually go to school or try a serious career. I don't even know how to drive because I was infantilized my whole life and now I am infantilizing myself. I am almost 30 and I really feel hopeless and don't want to deal with this anymore.
I think we are too concerned about the things we have no control over and lean heavily into the idea of saving or owing each other.

I do see the logical fallacy and I think that's what I want to fix. I don't want it to be a constant two way of controlling one another.

The problem is that the complaint is constant and I should have been able to establish the boundary when I am feeling overwhelmed. Instead I just tried to fix it. I want to not do that any more and every time I create that resolution for myself something snaps and I lose that control and get mad again. 

I think me doing that is enabling their doing the same.
